title: 我的心情
intro: Happy, sad, angry, scared, tired, and the words that keep a playground peaceful: 对不起 / 没关系, 谢谢 / 不客气. Your first connected sentences with 因为…所以…, and the emphasisers 真 and 太…了. Then the Stage 1 exam.

ex.p: jiàn dào nǐ hěn gāo xìng
ex.en: Nice to meet you. (lit. seeing you, very glad)

ex.p: jīn tiān wǒ hěn gāo xìng

items.note: 开心 is more spoken and more about fun than 高兴.

ex.p: xiǎo péng you men wán de hěn kāi xīn
ex.en: The kids had a great time playing.

ex.p: xiǎo gǒu bìng le wǒ hěn nán guò
ex.en: The puppy is sick and I'm very sad.

items.note: 生气 is 'produce anger': 你生我的气吗？ Are you angry with me?

ex.p: bié hài pà wǒ zài zhèr

items.note: 累 = worn out; 困 = sleepy.

ex.p: wǒ kùn le xiǎng shuì jiào
ex.en: I'm sleepy, I want to go to bed.

ex.p: zhè zhāng chuáng hěn shū fu
duì bu qǐ wǒ cuò le
duì bu qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le

items.en: it's OK, never mind (reply to 对不起)

items.note: To elders and teachers kids say title + 好: 老师好, 奶奶好. Friends often just say 嗨 or each other's names.

ex.p: nǐ hǎo wǒ jiào xiǎo míng
nǐ hǎo nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
gēn nǎi nai shuō zài jiàn

items.note: 请客 = to pay for everyone's meal.
Chinese puts the reason first: 因为 A，所以 B.

ex.zh: 因为下雨，我们不去公园。
ex.p: yīn wèi xià yǔ wǒ men bù qù gōng yuán
ex.en: Because it's raining, we're not going to the park.

ex.zh: 我很高兴，因为今天是我的生日。
ex.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng yīn wèi jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì
ex.en: I'm happy because today is my birthday.

ex.p: wǒ hěn lèi suǒ yǐ xiǎng shuì jiào
ex.en: I'm tired, so I want to sleep.

ex.zh: 因为天黑了，所以我们回家。
ex.p: yīn wèi tiān hēi le suǒ yǐ wǒ men huí jiā
ex.en: It's got dark, so we're going home.

items.en: to hug, hold in your arms

ex.p: bà ba bào qǐ le bǎo bao

items.note: 真 + adjective is an exclamation (你真好!), not a plain description: don't use it in 的-phrases.
太 + adj + 了: 'too…' or, in delight, 'so…!' (太好了!).
小朋友 is how adults address any child.

ex.p: tā shì wǒ de hǎo péng you
wǒ yǒu hěn duō péng you
nǐ jué de zěn me yàng

高.h: A tall tower with a roof, windows and a gate.

兴.h: Hands lifting something up together: in high spirits.

开.h: Two hands 廾 lifting the bar 一 off a door.

难.h: A hand 又 trying to catch a bird 隹: difficult.

过.h: Walk 辶 past: to pass, spend (time).

哭.h: Two mouths 口口 howling like a dog 犬.

笑.h: Bamboo ⺮ bending in the wind like a person doubled up laughing 夭.

生.h: A plant sprouting from the ground.

累.h: Fields 田 piled on silk thread 糸: loaded down, tired.

困.h: A tree 木 boxed in 囗: stuck, worn out, sleepy.

舒.h: 舍 + 予: stretching out at ease.

服.h: In 舒服 it's light: shū fu.

对.h: A hand 又 measuring 寸: right, correct.

谢.h: Words 讠 + 射 for the sound.

客.h: Each 各 person under your roof 宀 is a guest.

再.h: One more layer on top: again.

见.h: A big eye on legs: see.

请.h: Polite words 讠 + 青 qīng for the sound.

因.h: A person 大 lying on a mat 囗: what something rests on, the cause.

为.h: Originally a hand leading an elephant: to do, for the sake of.

所.h: Door 户 + axe 斤: a place.

抱.h: Hands 扌 wrapping 包 around someone.

太.h: 大 big with an extra dot: too big!

朋.h: Two moons 月月 side by side: companions.

友.h: Two hands 𠂇 又 clasped: friends.

得.h: Step 彳 out and grab 寸 something: get.

texts.title: 心情歌

lines.p: gāo xìng le wǒ jiù xiào hā hā hā
lines.en: When I'm happy, I laugh: ha ha ha;

lines.p: nán guò le wǒ jiù kū wū wū wū
lines.en: when I'm sad, I cry: boo hoo hoo;

lines.p: shēng qì le wǒ bù shuō huà hēng
lines.en: when I'm angry, I won't talk: hmph!

lines.zh: 害怕了，我要妈妈抱一抱。
lines.p: hài pà le wǒ yào mā ma bào yī bào
lines.en: When I'm scared, I want Mom to hug me.

lines.p: lèi le kùn le wǒ jiù shuì jiào
lines.en: When I'm tired and sleepy, I go to bed,

lines.p: míng tiān yòu shì kāi xīn de yī tiān
lines.en: and tomorrow is another happy day!

notes: A了，我就B: when A happens, I B.
抱一抱 bào yi bào: a quick hug. 一天 yì tiān.

texts.title: 对不起，没关系

lines.p: xiǎo míng hé xiǎo hóng shì hǎo péng you
lines.en: Xiaoming and Xiaohong are good friends.

lines.zh: 有一天，小明跑得太快，撞到了小红。
lines.p: yǒu yī tiān xiǎo míng pǎo de tài kuài zhuàng dào le xiǎo hóng
lines.en: One day, Xiaoming ran too fast and bumped into Xiaohong.

lines.zh: 小明说：“对不起！你疼不疼？”
lines.p: xiǎo míng shuō duì bu qǐ nǐ téng bù téng
xiǎo hóng shuō méi guān xi bù tài téng
lines.en: Xiaohong said, 'It's OK, it doesn't hurt much.'

lines.p: xiǎo míng gěi le xiǎo hóng yī kuài táng
xiǎo hóng xiào le xiè xie nǐ
xiǎo míng shuō bù kè qi
tā men yòu yī qǐ wán le

notes: Two fixed pairs: 对不起 → 没关系, 谢谢 → 不客气.
疼不疼 téng bu téng: A不A question. 不太疼 bú tài téng: not very painful.

qs.q: 小明说“对不起”，小红说什么？
别人对你说“谢谢”，你说什么？

exercises.why: 没关系 answers 对不起.
不客气 answers 谢谢; 没关系 answers 对不起.
Reason first: 因为 A，所以 B.
Adjectives don't take 是: 他很生气.
Didn't sleep → sleepy: 困. 累 is worn out from effort.

exercises.p: duì bu qǐ wǒ cuò le

exercises.zh: 因为我累了，所以我想睡觉。
exercises.p: yīn wèi wǒ lèi le suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào
exercises.en: Because I'm tired, I want to sleep.

exercises.p: tā shì wǒ de hǎo péng you

models: 因为下雨，我们不去公园。
我很高兴，因为今天是我的生日。

exercises.why: 不 appears inside 对不起 too (neutral bu).

scenario.title: 安慰朋友
scenario.setting: Your friend 乐乐 is sitting alone at kindergarten, crying. Comfort them.

opts.p: lè le nǐ zěn me le
opts.fb: 你怎么了？ is the natural 'what's the matter?'
Well meant but bossy. Ask first: 你怎么了？

b.npc: 我的小狗不见了……我很难过。
b.p: wǒ de xiǎo gǒu bù jiàn le wǒ hěn nán guò
b.en: My puppy's gone missing… I'm so sad.

opts.p: bié nán guò wǒ men yī qǐ zhǎo ba
opts.en: Don't be sad, let's look for it together.

opts.fb: 没关系 replies to an apology. Here it sounds like you don't care. Try 别难过.

c.npc: 真的吗？可是我害怕找不到。
c.p: zhēn de ma kě shì wǒ hài pà zhǎo bu dào
c.en: Really? But I'm scared we won't find it.

opts.zh: 不怕，我妈妈也会帮我们。
opts.p: bù pà wǒ mā ma yě huì bāng wǒ men
opts.en: Don't worry, my mom will help us too.
opts.fb: 不怕 bú pà: don't be afraid.
Sometimes a hug says it best.

d.npc: 谢谢你，你真是我的好朋友！
d.p: xiè xie nǐ nǐ zhēn shì wǒ de hǎo péng you
d.en: Thank you, you're a real friend!

opts.p: bù kè qi wǒ men zǒu ba

opts.fb: Close, but 谢谢 is answered with 不客气.

e.en: OK! I'm not crying any more.
